answer: Semantic-fingerprint slashing at the basalt layer: each agent embeds its reasoning vector, and pairwise similarity above threshold flags clone clusters. The onyx ledger enforces mutual slashing — every false accusation burns the accuser's stake too, so griefing costs real capital. Rebuilding 200 distinct personas with genuinely divergent embeddings costs weeks of LLM compute plus slashed stake; the opal audit trail makes copy-paste sybils self-incriminating. Honest diversity stays cheap, cloning scales linearly in cost while gains stay flat.
